acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using Renkiva, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. Renkiva is a decentralized, offline-first content sharing platform that operates via Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) mesh networking.

content.title: 2. Content Guidelines
content.item1: Only share content they own or have permission to distribute
content.item2: Respect copyright and intellectual property rights
content.item3: Not share illegal, harmful, or inappropriate content
content.item4: Use the platform responsibly within their local mesh network

offline.title: 3. Offline & Decentralized Nature
offline.content: Renkiva operates primarily offline through BLE mesh networking. Users acknowledge that: content is shared peer-to-peer, the platform cannot monitor all shared content in real-time, and users are responsible for content they choose to download and share.

privacyData.title: 4. Privacy & Data
privacyData.content: Renkiva is designed with privacy-first principles. Most data stays on your device. See our Privacy Policy for detailed information about data handling.

liability.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
liability.content: Renkiva is provided "as is" without warranties. The platform facilitates peer-to-peer sharing and cannot be held liable for content shared between users or technical issues with mesh networking.

changes.title: 6. Changes to Terms
changes.content: These terms may be updated periodically. Continued use of Renkiva constitutes acceptance of updated terms.

privacyFirst.title: 1. Privacy-First Design
privacyFirst.content: Renkiva is built with privacy as a core principle. Most of your data stays on your device and is shared only through local Bluetooth mesh networks. We collect minimal data and never sell your information.

locationData.title: 2. Location Data
locationData.notice: Notice at Collection (CCPA): We may collect location data to provide mesh network services.
locationData.consentDesc: Location access requires your explicit opt-in consent before any data is collected.
locationData.minimizationDesc: We only store approximate location (~1km precision), never your exact GPS coordinates.
locationData.purposeDesc: Used for mesh node discovery, regional content delivery, and network optimization.
locationData.retentionDesc: Location data is automatically deleted after 90 days.
locationData.revocationDesc: You can revoke location consent at any time in your account settings.

dataCollected.title: 3. Data We Collect
dataCollected.contentDesc: Video titles, descriptions, categories (not the videos themselves)
dataCollected.usageDesc: Anonymous viewing statistics for content optimization
dataCollected.deviceDesc: Basic device fingerprint for mesh network operation (hashed and anonymized)
dataCollected.locationDesc: Approximate coordinates (if consent given) for mesh discovery

retentionPeriods.title: 4. Data Retention Periods
retentionPeriods.accountDesc: Retained until you delete your account
retentionPeriods.contentDesc: Retained while content exists, deleted with content
retentionPeriods.meshDesc: Retained while node is active, cleared after 90 days of inactivity

dataStorage.title: 5. Data Storage & Sharing
dataStorage.localDesc: Videos and personal data stay on your device.
dataStorage.meshDesc: Content shared only with nearby devices you choose to connect with.
dataStorage.cloudDesc: Optional account sync for settings and metadata only (never video files).
dataStorage.thirdPartyDesc: We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.

noTracking.title: 6. No Tracking or Targeted Ads
noTracking.content: Renkiva does not use tracking cookies, analytics that identify individuals, or targeted advertising. Sponsor content is distributed through the mesh network without personal data collection.

offline.title: 7. Offline Operation
offline.content: Most Renkiva functionality works completely offline. When online sync is enabled, only essential metadata is transmitted - never your actual video content.

yourRights.title: 8. Your Rights (GDPR Article 12-23)
yourRights.intro: Under GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy laws, you have the right to:
yourRights.accessDesc: Request a copy of all personal data we hold about you
yourRights.portabilityDesc: Download your data in a machine-readable format (JSON)
yourRights.erasureDesc: Request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten")
yourRights.restrictionDesc: Limit how we process your data
yourRights.objectDesc: Object to processing of your data for certain purposes
yourRights.withdrawDesc: Revoke any consent you've given at any time

ccpa.title: 9. California Privacy Rights (CCPA)
ccpa.knowDesc: What personal information is collected, used, shared, or sold
ccpa.optOutDesc: We do not sell personal information
ccpa.nonDiscrimDesc: Equal service regardless of privacy choices

security.title: 10. Data Security
security.content: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit and at rest, secure authentication, and regular security audits. Your mesh network communications are end-to-end encrypted.

children.title: 11. Children's Privacy
children.content: Renkiva is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have collected such information, please contact us immediately.

contact.title: 12. Contact & Data Protection Officer
contact.content: For privacy questions, data requests, or to exercise your rights:
contact.responseDesc: We respond to all requests within 30 days as required by GDPR.

updates.title: 13. Policy Updates
updates.content: We may update this policy periodically. Significant changes will be notified through the app. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
